*** AGENCY FEES PAID BY THE PROPERTY OWNER ***

For sale: commercial premises with a 5.20% YIELD, leased to a tenant with TOTAL solvency in one of the best commercial areas of Madrid.

It has an area of 95 m², distributed over two floors, at street level, next to the Alfonso XIII Metro station.

Currently, the asset provides a yield of 5.20%, a return much higher than any bank deposit or residential rental (WITHOUT the regulatory risks we are experiencing with potential maximum rent price caps, rent freezes, or the legal insecurity regarding potential defaults in residential rentals).

An EXCELLENT investment opportunity with no risk to your money and an immediate return on capital.

Call us, we will be happy to provide you with information without obligation.

*** AGENCY FEES PAID BY THE PROPERTY OWNER ***.
